description: A time series of one numeric futures column for one contract: `points` is an ascending array of { ts, value } with `ts` in epoch milliseconds and `value` the number or null. `from`/`to` are ISO-8601 datetimes; `interval` is one of 1m, 5m, 1h, 1d, and an interval finer than the plan's (1m on Ultra and PAYG, 5m on Max, 1h on Pro, 1d on Free) is an HTTP 403. Futures history is a rolling window: `futures.historyDays` and `futures.availableFrom` in blackforge_catalog, shorter on Free; a `from` before the plan's window is moved forward to it without an error, so the first point can start later than asked. Flows (volume, taker volume, trades, liquidations) are summed into a bucket; prices, funding and open interest are the bucket's last minute (`rollup` on each catalog entry). At most 50,000 points, newest kept, with `truncated: true` when cut. A column above the plan comes back with empty `points` and is listed in `columnsOmitted`. When any bucket is flagged, `qualitySummary` (`{ flaggedBuckets, of, flags }`) names the futures quality flags; no `qualitySummary` means no bucket in the range was flagged.

metric.description: Numeric futures column key from blackforge_catalog `futures.metrics`, e.g. fundingRate, openInterestValue.
